description: Stormcaller's Pauldrons Level 60 Bring the Qiraji Bindings of Dominance, 2 Idols of Life, 5 Gold Scarabs and 5 Crystal Scarabs to Andorgos in Ahn'Qiraj. You must also attain Neutral reputation with the Brood of Nozdormu to complete this quest. Requirements: - Qiraji Bindings of Dominance - Idol of Life x 2 - Gold Scarab x 5 - Crystal Scarab x 5 - Brood of Nozdormu:
name: Stormcaller's Pauldrons
